before_action.text: 单肺通气的安排正在复核。开胸后如果需要调整，我会直接通报。
before_action.text_en: The one-lung ventilation plan is being checked. I'll report promptly if adjustments are needed after entry.

before_action.text: 开胸器械、肋间牵开器和长吸引准备好了。
before_action.text_en: Thoracotomy instruments, a rib spreader, and long suction are ready.

after_resolution.text: 胸壁进入完成，肋间组织已经保护，先不要把牵开撑得过大。
after_resolution.text_en: Chest entry is complete. The intercostal tissues are protected; avoid excessive spreading.

before_action.text: 肺门的支气管和肺动脉贴得很近，先按照解剖关系逐一辨认。
before_action.text_en: The bronchus and pulmonary artery lie close together at the hilum. Identify them one by one.

before_action.text: 无创肺钳、湿垫和深部吸引已接好。
before_action.text_en: Atraumatic lung graspers, moist pads, and deep suction are ready.

after_resolution.text: 肺叶牵拉由我维持，留出中央操作空间，别遮住血管分支。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll maintain lung retraction and keep the central field clear without obscuring vessel branches.

after_resolution.text: 肺门操作可能影响通气配合，我会持续观察氧合趋势。
after_resolution.text_en: Hilar work may affect ventilation. I'll keep watching oxygenation trends.

before_action.text: 这条肺动脉分支壁很薄，先确认远端走向，避免从分叉处硬拉。
before_action.text_en: This pulmonary arterial branch is thin-walled. Confirm its distal course; do not pull at the bifurcation.

before_action.text: 血管环、直角钳和细血管剪，按顺序递。
before_action.text_en: Vessel loop, right-angle clamp, and fine vascular scissors, ready in sequence.

before_action.text: 分叉后壁由我留出空间，血管环穿过时不会被牵拉器挡住。
before_action.text_en: I'll clear the posterior side of the bifurcation so the vessel loop has room to pass.

after_resolution.text: 已辨认的分支我会单独保护，下一步支气管分离不能碰到它。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll protect the identified branch separately during the upcoming bronchial dissection.

after_resolution.text: 备用细吸引和血管缝线都已核对，需要时可以追加上台。
after_resolution.text_en: Backup fine suction and vascular sutures are checked and available if needed.

before_action.text: 支气管周围还有营养血管，松解范围别超过吻合所需。
before_action.text_en: There are feeding vessels around the bronchus. Limit release to what the anastomosis requires.

before_action.text: 长柄精细剪、无创镊和湿纱布。
before_action.text_en: Long fine scissors, atraumatic forceps, and moist pads.

after_resolution.text: 支气管近远端已经显露，接下来可以具体核对保留长度。
after_resolution.text_en: The proximal and distal bronchial segments are exposed. We can assess the preserved lengths precisely.

after_resolution.text: 接下来涉及气道操作，通气配合由我保持即时沟通。
after_resolution.text_en: Airway work is coming up. I'll keep ventilation coordination immediate.

before_action.text: 先看计划切缘有没有足够健康的支气管壁，不能为了省长度留下病变。
before_action.text_en: Check that the planned margin contains adequate healthy bronchial wall. Do not preserve length at the expense of clearance.

before_action.text: 肺动脉重建的空间也要预留，切除范围不能只从气道一侧判断。
before_action.text_en: Leave room for pulmonary artery reconstruction too. The resection cannot be planned from the airway alone.

after_resolution.text: 按选定边界继续，标本方向和保留结构都重新口头核对。
after_resolution.text_en: Proceed along the selected margins. Read back specimen orientation and preserved structures.

after_resolution.text: 切缘标记与送检容器准备好了，病理交接按实际标本登记。
after_resolution.text_en: Margin labels and specimen containers are ready. Pathology handoff will follow the actual specimen record.

before_action.text: 先保护保留侧的血供，再处理最后一段支气管周围连接。
before_action.text_en: Protect the blood supply of the remaining lung before dividing the last peribronchial attachments.

before_action.text: 细刀片、弯剪和无创持组织钳。
before_action.text_en: Fine blade, curved scissors, and atraumatic tissue forceps.

after_resolution.text: 保留端口径可以继续评估，下一步牵拉要避免损伤吻合缘。
after_resolution.text_en: The preserved airway diameter can now be assessed. Avoid traction on the future anastomotic edge.

after_resolution.text: 下一组支气管吻合线已经单独放好，暂不与血管线混用。
after_resolution.text_en: The bronchial anastomotic sutures are set aside separately from the vascular sutures.

before_action.text: 取出病变肺叶时我护住肺门残端，别让标本重量牵拉吻合区。
before_action.text_en: I'll protect the hilar stumps during lobar removal so the specimen weight does not pull on the reconstruction site.

before_action.text: 切除器械和标本袋准备接收肺叶。
before_action.text_en: Resection instruments and a specimen bag are ready for the lobe.

after_resolution.text: 保留肺的支气管口现在完全可见，可以检查两端吻合方向。
after_resolution.text_en: The remaining bronchial ends are fully visible. We can check their anastomotic alignment.

before_action.text: 两段支气管的口径和软骨环排列不同，缝合时要均匀分配张力。
before_action.text_en: The bronchial ends differ in caliber and cartilage-ring alignment. Distribute suture tension evenly.

before_action.text: 支气管细缝线、小持针器和无创镊。
before_action.text_en: Fine bronchial sutures, a small needle holder, and atraumatic forceps.

before_action.text: 我把保留肺叶的姿势先固定，缝合时别让气道端口来回转动。
before_action.text_en: I'll steady the remaining lobe so the airway ends don't rotate during suturing.

after_resolution.text: 我维持吻合口周围的空间，接下来操作血管时不要扭转这段气道。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll preserve space around the bronchial anastomosis. Avoid twisting it during vascular work.

after_resolution.text: 气道吻合已进入待检状态，通气试验会在合适节点配合进行。
after_resolution.text_en: The airway anastomosis is awaiting assessment. We'll coordinate the ventilation test at the appropriate stage.

before_action.text: 本例的肺动脉分支确实需要重建，先核对血管缺损长度和流出方向。
before_action.text_en: This case requires pulmonary artery branch reconstruction. Confirm defect length and outflow direction.

before_action.text: 无损血管钳、血管缝线和小持针器，换血管组。
before_action.text_en: Atraumatic vascular clamps, vascular sutures, and a small needle holder. Switching to the vascular set.

after_resolution.text: 检查吻合段与支气管之间的间隙，不能让两条重建线相互牵扯。
after_resolution.text_en: Check the space between the vascular and bronchial anastomoses; neither should pull on the other.

after_resolution.text: 血管重建之后我会继续复核氧合和灌注表现，必要时随时协调。
after_resolution.text_en: After vascular reconstruction, I'll keep reviewing oxygenation and perfusion and coordinate as needed.

before_action.text: 准备按计划调整通气，复查漏气和剩余肺组织的复张表现。
before_action.text_en: I'll adjust ventilation as planned to assess air leakage and expansion of the remaining lung.

before_action.text: 我盯支气管吻合，第二助手看血管通路；两边结果必须对应。
before_action.text_en: I'll watch the bronchial anastomosis; the second assistant checks vascular flow. Both findings must agree.

after_resolution.text: 按选定的复查方案完成确认，有疑点就在关胸前处理。
after_resolution.text_en: Complete the review according to the selected plan. Resolve concerns before chest closure.

after_resolution.text: 胸腔引流和备用吸引已备好，检查结束后可以切换器械。
after_resolution.text_en: Chest drains and backup suction are ready. We can switch instruments after the assessment.

before_action.text: 引流位置和肺门止血最后再看一遍，我来守住暴露。
before_action.text_en: One last look at drain positioning and hilar hemostasis. I'll maintain exposure.

before_action.text: 胸管固定线、肋间关闭器械和皮肤缝线。
before_action.text_en: Chest-tube fixation sutures, intercostal closure tools, and skin sutures.

after_resolution.text: 终末器械、纱布和针数核对完成，胸管记录已并入交接。
after_resolution.text_en: Final instrument, sponge, and needle counts are complete. Chest-tube details are in the handoff.

after_resolution.text: 复苏团队会收到单肺通气经过以及两处吻合的观察重点。
after_resolution.text_en: The recovery team will receive the one-lung ventilation course and monitoring priorities for both anastomoses.
